description: See the multi-step pricing pipelines Last Price publishes and the stages they are built from: for each reference pipeline its name, what it is for, its topology, latency and cost ceilings, the consent it needs and the trust zones it may run in, and the stage catalogue with each stage's layer and tags. To run one without a key, use run_reference_pipeline once it is switched on (until then it answers 501 pipeline_execution_unavailable rather than a simulated price). To price an item from photos use price_from_capture; to price from numbers use compute_price, or run_pricing_chain for a chain you define. Public: needs no credential.
name: list_pricing_pipelines
